rho_reference.protocol: strong rho (examples/n83_rho_optimization_eval, rho_config fold backend, 64 lanes, dp 6) on each of the 20 panel points, three draws per point with seeds 2026101900 + 10 i + d, in the same runner allocation as the IC arms (PROTOCOL.md)
rho_reference.unit: group additions per one-target solve (counted, from the rho receipts); IC wall seconds against rho online seconds reported beside
rho_reference.binary_or_process: one GitHub Actions runner allocation (run 39296352594), both binaries built from the PR head 4b2b3efa6 in the same job
rho_reference.strongest_available_basis: N83 a=1 Koblitz curve: negation and the Frobenius eigenvalue, both folded by the strong reference (signed Frobenius, 2n = 166 classes)
rho_reference.gae_band_statistic: padd arm, mean per one-target solve over the 20 points. IC group additions = rank_probes / 2 (each padd candidate's two partner roots x(T+R), x(T-R) come from one point addition with a shared inversion; rank anchors and lifts not counted, so a lower bound). IC unpriced = 2 x (rank + target probes) (one canonicalisation, one table query each) + 2 x regular index states (one S3 root solve, one insertion each) + target probes / 2 (target-scan S3 root solves). Rho = group additions + w x (canonicalizations + partition hashes + table inserts + table queries) from its receipts (analysis.json section_5a).
rho_reference.order_basis: rho below the IC at w = 0, 0.1 and 1 (34x, 41x, 61x)
